candidate.title: Embed topic retrieval can crash or silently no-op when embedbyusername is blank/missing, leaving embeds stuck on infinite “loading”
reports: lib/topicretriever.rb:49 — a blank embedbyusername raises on downcase after every valid-host cache miss, and the loading page keeps re-enqueuing the permanently failing retrieval.

lib/topicretriever.rb:50 — return if user.blank? silently gives up when embedbyusername is '' (the shipped default) or names a missing user, so the job reports success and the embed stays on "loading" forever with nothing logged.

lib/topicretriever.rb:50 — [p1, confidence 100] return if user.blank? silently completes retrieval when embedbyusername is missing or names a deleted user, leaving every requester in an endless loading loop with no error or topic.

lib/topicretriever.rb:49 — [p1, confidence 100] user.where(usernamelower: sitesetting.embedbyusername.downcase).first raises nomethoderror when embedbyusername is blank, so a valid embed request under the default configuration repeatedly displays “loading” while every retrieval job fails.
candidate.example: lib/topicretriever.rb:49 — a blank embedbyusername raises on downcase after every valid-host cache miss, and the loading page keeps re-enqueuing the permanently failing retrieval.
